context: Add KIND_CLUSTER_KEY plus an ALTER TABLE ... CLUSTER BY (cols) rule (and CLUSTER BY on CREATE TABLE) to the shared classifier, treating RESUME RECLUSTER as maintenance like OPTIMIZE. Add SnowflakeTuningIntrospector reading INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES.CLUSTERING_KEY, bounded to the ledger's tables, normalizing the catalog form defensively (Snowflake may report LINEAR(a, b) or (a, b)).
description: Snowflake DOES apply real tuning (ALTER TABLE ... CLUSTER BY, plus RESUME RECLUSTER) and those statements ARE already captured — apply_standard_unified_tuning wraps the connection in a recording_connection(PHASE_DDL) and RecordingConnection.cursor() proxies execute, so snowflake.py needs no ledger references of its own. The defect is downstream: the shared classifier has no rule for ALTER TABLE ... CLUSTER BY, so every clustering statement classifies as 'unverifiable', which BLOCKS the upgrade. Verified at develop: a ledger holding ALTER TABLE LINEITEM CLUSTER BY (...) plus RESUME RECLUSTER yields two unverifiable entries and corroborated=False. Consequence: a tuned Snowflake run can never reach applied_verified, and its receipt reads 'no corroboration rule for this statement' rather than naming the clustering key. Snowflake also has no get_tuning_introspector, so there is nothing to corroborate against even once classification works. INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES.CLUSTERING_KEY is the catalog source; snowflake.py already reads it to decide whether to re-cluster.

deferrals.reason: w3 needs live Snowflake credentials; AGENTS.md requires explicit approval for live cloud tests and none was given. parse_clustering_key accepts both documented forms defensively, but the guess is unverified — and it fails CLOSED (runs silently never verify), so it must not be assumed correct.
deferrals.summary: Confirm against a live Snowflake which text INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES.CLUSTERING_KEY actually returns (LINEAR(A, B) vs (A, B)) and that a clustered table reaches applied_verified

preserves.behavior: An unrecognized clustering statement must keep BLOCKING the upgrade, never be silently dropped
